title: introduce presubmit-qualifier and dep-slimdown workflow
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Adds a presubmit qualifier workflow that gates large dependency churn and a dep-slimdown tool that identifies and proposes removal/moving of dev-only transitive deps. No functional changes to runtime behavior. Rollout notes included.
description:
Context and motivation:
This PR introduces two complementary changes to reduce noisy dependency churn and long CI times caused by large transitive dev-dependencies and to make presubmit checks more deterministic for repo health. The presubmit-qualifier workflow enforces that PRs which touch package manifests or lockfiles include a short human-provided qualifier tag (prepended in the PR title or via PR body metadata) explaining the scope and risk of the dep change. The dep-slimdown tool is a lightweight analyzer that scans the monorepo for dev-only transitive dependencies (test frameworks, large babel/tooling, legacy polyfills) and creates a proposal (automated branch) to move them to a dev workspace or remove them where unused.

What changed (summary):
- Added .github/workflows/presubmit-qualifier.yml: new presubmit job that validates qualifier and rejects wide-impact dep bumps without the qualifier. Includes an allowlist for automated dependency bots and a risk-level header parser.
- Added tools/presubmit-qualifier/ : node-based checker + small TTL cache for PR meta so we don't hammer GraphQL on heavy runs.
- Added tools/dep-slimdown/: Python analyzer that creates a patch proposal and a behavioral report listing candidates to drop or move.
- Staged CI lanes updated (ci/pipelines/staged-lanes.yml) to run lint/unit fastpath on PR tip, run dep-slimdown on schedule and on push to master as an advisory report.
- package.json and pnpm-lock.yaml updated in the repo root to adopt pnpm workspaces for dev tooling (non-breaking for runtime packages) and to demonstrate the tooling path for teams migrating.

Motivation / benefits:
- Reduce noisy bundling of dev transitive deps into developer images and caches
- Give reviewers quick context for large dep PRs, preventing accidental wide-rollouts
- Automate low-risk cleanup suggestions to keep the repo lean and CI faster

Checklist (what I did):
- [x] Implement presubmit qualifier action and tests
- [x] Implement dep-slimdown analyzer and integration test against a sampled workspace
- [x] Wire presubmit step into staged CI lanes
- [x] Update docs: docs/ci/presubmit-qualifier.md with migration and usage
- [x] Add rollback/opt-out labels for emergency bypass

Commits (high-level):
- feat(presubmit): add qualifier action and caching
- feat(dep-slimdown): initial analyzer, report format and auto-branching
- chore(ci): wire presubmit check into staged lanes
- chore(docs): presubmit-qualifier usage and migration guide
- ci: update pnpm workspace bootstrap script

Changed files (high level):
- .github/workflows/presubmit-qualifier.yml
- ci/pipelines/staged-lanes.yml
- tools/presubmit-qualifier/index.js
- tools/presubmit-qualifier/README.md
- tools/dep-slimdown/run.py
- tools/dep-slimdown/report_formatter.py
- tools/dep-slimdown/tests/sample_project.json
- docs/ci/presubmit-qualifier.md
- package.json
- pnpm-workspace.yaml
- pnpm-lock.yaml
- scripts/bootstrap-pnpm.sh
- README.md (root) updated

Testing and CI notes:
- CI initially failed on a flaky GraphQL quota check in the presubmit action; added a TTL cache and retry, green on rerun.
- All unit and lint checks pass in the final run. Integration smoke (basic serve) validated for main services.
- dep-slimdown runs are advisory by default; the presubmit action does not reject PRs based solely on the analyzer output — it surfaces recommendations.

Rollout plan:
- Merge to main behind a brief canary window. The presubmit job has an opt-out label (ci/presubmit-skip) for emergency hotfixes.
- Monitor PR velocity and number of blocked dep PRs for two weeks and iterate on allowlist rules.

Backward compatibility and migration:
- pnpm addition is opt-in for workspace owners; runtime packages remain the same. CI bootstrap supports both npm/yarn/pnpm for contributors during migration.

Follow-ups:
- Convert GitHub Dependabot config to produce qualifier-compatible PRs (ENG-1302)
- Add an admin dashboard to review dep-slimdown recommendations centrally (ENG-1310)

If reviewers want smaller diffs I can split pnpm bootstrap into a separate PR; kept together to validate the real path for migration.
